title: Order
summary: An order records a consistent notion of before, below, or no greater than.

content.plain: An order records a consistent notion of before, below, or no greater than.
content.exact: A partial order ≤ is reflexive, antisymmetric, and transitive. A total order additionally compares every pair.
content.example: Subset inclusion partially orders the subsets of a set.
content.caveat: Not every pair is comparable in a partial order.
